package_info.package_name: N/A (general web loyalty program attack patterns)
package_info.why_malicious: The report describes two primary attack vectors targeting online loyalty programs: credential harvesting via transparent overlays (phishing) and malicious code injection on legitimate loyalty program pages to exfiltrate sensitive customer data. Both methods result in unauthorized access and theft of personal and financial information.

execution_context.file_location: fake loyalty program login page (transparent overlay)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: HTML/CSS/JavaScript code that mimics the legitimate loyalty program login page, capturing user credentials and sending them to an attacker-controlled server.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When a user attempts to log in, the code captures the entered credentials and transmits them to an external attacker-controlled endpoint, enabling credential theft.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code is designed to deceive users into entering sensitive information into a fake page, which is then exfiltrated.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Users expect to interact with the legitimate loyalty program page, not a lookalike controlled by attackers.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate login pages collect credentials, but do not exfiltrate them to unauthorized domains.
key_indicators: Visual mimicry of legitimate login page
Network requests to untrusted or unexpected domains

execution_context.trigger: page load or user interaction on legitimate loyalty program page
execution_context.file_location: injected JavaScript on actual loyalty program page

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious JavaScript embedded in the loyalty program page that reads user data (contact info, card details, preferences) and sends it to an external server.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: On page load or user interaction, the code accesses sensitive user data from the page and transmits it to an attacker-controlled endpoint, resulting in data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code surreptitiously collects and exfiltrates sensitive data without user consent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal loyalty program pages should not transmit user data to unknown third parties.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Analytics scripts may collect non-sensitive data, but not full personal or payment information.
key_indicators: Access to sensitive form fields or cookies

attack_chain.action: User is lured to a fake loyalty program login page (transparent overlay) or visits a compromised legitimate page.
attack_chain.leads_to: Credential or data capture by attacker

attack_chain.action: Malicious code captures credentials or sensitive data and exfiltrates it to attacker infrastructure.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains unauthorized access to loyalty accounts and personal information

attack_chain.action: Attacker uses stolen data for account takeover, fraud, or resale on underground markets.
attack_chain.leads_to: Financial loss, privacy breach, and reputational damage for both customer and business

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected network requests from loyalty program pages to unrecognized domains
Credential or sensitive data capture on non-standard login pages
JavaScript accessing and transmitting form data or cookies externally
file_indicators: Injected or unauthorized JavaScript in loyalty program page source
Presence of lookalike login pages hosted on non-canonical domains
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests to attacker-controlled or untrusted domains
Data POSTs containing credential or PII payloads
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor loyalty program pages for unauthorized JavaScript or overlays, scan for outbound network requests to unrecognized domains, and audit for the presence of lookalike login pages. Use journey scans with varied user profiles to detect data leakage or exfiltration attempts.
